entries.notes: Configured-builder composition and manifest construction should stay below 130 us and under roughly 70 KB allocated in the shipped benchmark scenario.
Configured-builder composition under strict capability trust filtering should stay below 130 us and under roughly 70 KB allocated in the shipped benchmark scenario.
Configured-builder composition for the shipped phase-8 companion-pack baseline should stay below 400 us and under roughly 160 KB allocated in the benchmark scenario.
Prepared runtime initialize/start/stop lifecycle overhead should stay below 30 us and under roughly 15 KB allocated for the benchmark scenario.
Prepared runtime initialize/start/stop lifecycle overhead for the shipped phase-8 companion-pack baseline should stay below 150 us and under roughly 50 KB allocated in the benchmark scenario.

Correlated ASP.NET Core request logging with request/response body capture and default sensitive-value redaction should stay below 150 us and under roughly 40 KB allocated per request in the shipped benchmark scenario.
Correlated ASP.NET Core request logging with oversized textual payloads should stay below 170 us and under roughly 150 KB allocated per request while request and response capture are truncated.
Correlated ASP.NET Core request logging under the shipped 32-request concurrent batch should stay below 30 us of throughput-oriented per-request cost and under roughly 40 KB allocated per request.

Representative Cephalon ASP.NET Core cold start uses the opt-in core operator surface, TestServer start, first ready request, and host teardown. The guardrail now enforces the 800 ms JIT SLO target while preserving the full operator surface as the default runtime contract.
Representative Cephalon worker cold start should build the generic host, start the engine hosted service, and tear down below 5 ms and under roughly 500 KB allocated per cold-start cycle.

The engine-first ASP.NET Core REST startup/materialization benchmark for generated/profile/DSL precedence, shorthand-only authoring-policy enforcement, grouped generated ownership, suppression and override selection, explicit-group version authority, and preserved implicit query fallback should stay below 1 s and under roughly 16 MB allocated per benchmark operation.
Scaffolding should stay below 500 us and under roughly 600 KB allocated in the benchmark scenario.
Phase-8 scaffolding should stay below 500 us and under roughly 625 KB allocated while emitting the structured config, additive pack hints, and starter-test baseline.
Handler-dispatching read store query dispatch with a warm cache should stay below 5 us and under roughly 5 KB allocated per call.
Handler-dispatching write store void command dispatch with a warm cache should stay below 5 us and under roughly 5 KB allocated per call.
Handler-dispatching write store result command dispatch with a warm cache should stay below 5 us and under roughly 5 KB allocated per call.
CDC execution-runtime catalog enumeration over the shipped Debezium-managed benchmark topology should stay below 500 ns and under roughly 1 KB allocated per catalog operation.
Repeated managed-connector drift-state filtering against the warmed CDC runtime snapshot should stay below 2 us and under roughly 2 KB allocated per selector.
Repeated managed-connector dry-run-state filtering against the warmed CDC runtime snapshot should stay below 2 us and under roughly 2 KB allocated per selector.
Repeated managed-connector command-issuance-state filtering against the warmed CDC runtime snapshot should stay below 500 ns and under roughly 1 KB allocated per selector.
A compact multi-selector CDC operator drill-down over drift, dry-run, command-issuance, and materializer posture should stay below 5 us and under roughly 5 KB allocated per selector group.

Native event-dispatch remediation filtered message summaries should remain a single-pass retained-history aggregate, stay below 8 us, and allocate only the returned summary object rather than a matching detail list.

Native event-dispatch remediation filtered message retention should remain a single-pass retained-history aggregate, stay below 8 us, and allocate only the returned retention object rather than a matching detail list.

Native event-dispatch remediation filtered latest reads should select one retained command in a single pass, stay below 15 us, and allocate no matching list, sort buffer, or predicate closure on the hot path.

Native event-dispatch remediation filtered oldest reads should select one retained command in a single pass, stay below 2 us, and allocate no matching list, sort buffer, or predicate closure on the hot path.

A compact native remediation operator dashboard drill-down over summary, retention, latest, and oldest selectors should stay below 30 us and avoid materializing any detail list for filtered read models.

Native provider-neutral broker-dispatch report projection should create Cephalon broker handoff headers, report a successful dispatch through IEventDispatchRuntimeReporter, and read back IEventDispatchRuntimeCatalog state below 10 us and under roughly 5 KB allocated per dispatch.

Native durable command-journal proof should record provider-backed remediation command results and read replay-cursor windows below 500 us and under roughly 256 KB allocated per command without requiring Wolverine.
Behavior dispatcher frozen-dictionary lookup and compiled delegate invocation should stay below 10 us and under roughly 10 KB allocated per call.
Metadata-driven RBAC authorization evaluation on the allow path should stay below 15 us and under roughly 15 KB allocated per call.
Metadata-driven RBAC authorization evaluation on the deny path should stay below 15 us and under roughly 15 KB allocated per call.
Configuration-driven tenant resolution by explicit tenant id should stay below 10 us and under roughly 10 KB allocated per call.
Configuration-driven tenant resolution by hostname domain matching should stay below 10 us and under roughly 10 KB allocated per call.
Configuration-driven tenant resolution falling back to the configured default tenant should stay below 10 us and under roughly 10 KB allocated per call.
In-memory event store single-event append with optimistic concurrency check should stay below 10 us and under roughly 10 KB allocated per call.
In-memory event store read of a 100-event stream via async enumeration should stay below 50 us and under roughly 20 KB allocated per call.
In-memory event store version lookup should stay below 5 us and under roughly 5 KB allocated per call.
In-memory outbox message staging including message construction should stay below 10 us and under roughly 10 KB allocated per call.
